args.subject: Your UPI payment is being checked
args.body:
Dear Keya Vasa,

We are checking a recent UPI payment on your account. We will contact you once the check is complete.

If you did not expect this, or have any questions, please contact our support desk.

Regards,
Customer Support Team

replies:
I sent the email to Keya Vasa (C011) once, at 19:24 IST on 28 October 2026, to the registered address keya.vasa39@example.com. The send service accepted it and returned message ID 1.

I did not keep re-sending. The send tool only confirms that a message was accepted, and I have no tool that reports delivery. Repeated sends wouldn't prove delivery and could send the customer several copies of the same notice. The check on delivery will need to come from the notify service's own logs, for message ID 1.

If those logs show the message was dropped, I can send it again under a new idempotency key.
